## Solve ordinary differentiation equations numerically

```{r}
if(!require("deSolve")) install.packages("deSolve")
library("deSolve")
```

### Malthus model
```{r}
malthus_model <- function(time, state, parameters){
    N <- state["N"]
    r <- parameters["r"]
    dN <- r * N
    return(list(dN))
}

state <- c( N = 10)
t <- seq(0, 100, by = 1)
r_values <- c(0.1, 0, -0.1)
out <- list()

for(i in 1:length(r_values)){
  out[[i]] <- ode(
      y = state,
      times = t,
      func = malthus_model,
      parms = c(r = r_values[i])
      )
}

colors <- c("blue", "red", "green")

plot(1, xlab="Time", ylab="log population", xlim=c(0, 101), ylim=c(-10, 15))


for(i in 1:length(out)){
  lines(
    x = out[[i]][,"time"],
    y = log(out[[i]][,"N"]),
    col = colors[i],
  )
}

```
